title: Wright Field consultant lives with Brown family

tellings.quote:
he actually had a
technical consultant named Charles Wyatt
Miller from right Airfield living with
his family at all times

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, passes on what Linda Brown, a member of the Brown family, told him: that in the 1950s her family always had a technical consultant named Charles Wyatt Miller living with them. Miller, Michels says, came from Wright Field, a US military airfield in Ohio. If true, it would suggest the military was keeping a close eye on the family and its work.
